what: item 5: prefill cells - exact-scorer three-way, GDN chunked, PF_GEMM/PF_PAD isolate; gate and adoption

window.resource_note: the 68,000 MiB gate was unreachable after the desktop baseline grew (two attempts at 67.2-67.7k); the cell cap was lowered 66G -> 64G and the gate to 66,000 MiB with the reason recorded in the script header

scorer_three_way_128k.verdict: the fp16 arm is the fastest scorer (select 1.71 s vs 4.32 s exact and ~10 s radix); B vs A total prefill -0.56% (tie); #1298 closes with this data

gdn_chunked_32k.verdict: above the +3% gate; output-changing (FP16 operands) -> gated

pf_isolate_128k.verdict: PF_GEMM alone +2.56% (below the +3% gate); +PF_PAD +4.41% (passes); PAD is output-changing -> gated

gate.parity: hip_gdn_chunked PASS on card; iq_parity PASS
gate.needle: 8K-token prompt with the code 739154 at its middle, greedy, thinking off: base1 PASS (8 s), GDN PASS (7 s), PF PASS (7 s), base2 PASS (7 s), answer identical in all four
gate.why_not_the_short_battery: both changes are prefill-only and their paths need a prompt chunk far larger than the 8-prompt battery's inputs, so the battery would never execute them; the declared gate is the parity test + the 8K needle

adoption.config: serve-8081.json env += STRATA_GDN_CHUNKED=1, STRATA_PF_GEMM=1, STRATA_PF_PAD=1 (with STRATA_ROUTE_PRIOR=0.5 already live)
adoption.restart: health ok after ~24 s; Paris smoke stop
adoption.rollback: restore .bak-prefill-pre and restart; unsetting the three envs restores base prefill
